comparison_rule.exact_is_not_byte_exact: 'Exact' under this rule is NOT byte equality, and never was. REPAIR-PLAN.md 6.4: ex:art46-p2-e and ex:art46-p2-f carry U+2019 where sources/art46.txt carries U+0027, and the gate scores both exact solely because U+2019 folds to U+0027. If the folds were removed or tightened, those two would stop resolving and the count would fall by 2 with no file having changed.
comparison_rule.quoting_rule: NO fidelity percentage may be quoted without naming the contract it was computed under. The two contracts in use, and their values as of 2026-08-19 after session S-D re-measured them:  (a) NORMALISED (this rule) - 126/126 grounded nodes resolved = 100.0%; 57 of 63 grounding provisions exact, 6 abridged, 0 mismatch, 0 no-anchor.  (b) BYTE EQUALITY - 59/74 anchors with a same-unit_id source unit are byte-identical to that unit; of the remaining 15, 5 are proper byte substrings and 10 are '...' elisions, every one of them named in sources/g0-expected.json byte_gate.allow_divergent. Before session S-B-note it was 0/74.  CORRECTED 2026-08-19 (AUDIT-v0.md Q1 divergence 2): this field read '124/126 grounded nodes resolved = 98.4%; 55 of 63 grounding provisions exact' and '57/74' - the S-B-note values, left unrevised when S-C Task 2 de-abridged art13-p2-f and art6-p3 and moved them. Both values are now GATED rather than merely recorded: sources/g0_source_gate.py exits 1 if the normalised figure is not reached and exits 3 if the byte figure is not.
comparison_rule.statement: Two strings are EQUAL for fidelity purposes iff they are equal after NFC normalisation, typographic folds, and whitespace collapse, applied in that order. This is the rule the G0-source gate has always used; it is stated here because it had never been written down as the comparison rule, only as a processing note.
steps: typographic folds (curly quotes -> ASCII, dashes -> '-', non-breaking and thin spaces -> U+0020)
whitespace collapse (runs of whitespace -> a single U+0020, ends trimmed)

normalisation_note: The 'normalisation' field names the PRODUCTION pipeline that built sources/*.txt. 'comparison_rule' names the rule anchors are COMPARED under. They coincide today; they are separate fields because they are separate claims.
